dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Nathan Buns is a very cute 14-year-old gentleman looking for a patient and understanding home where he can enjoy his golden years. He has been highly fearful while in his crate and will need someone who is willing to take things slowly and give him time to feel safe. The good news is that Nathan Buns is highly food motivated, and with a gentle approach and some tasty treats, he does seem to warm up nicely and show more of his sweet personality. He is an active and playful guy despite his age and enjoys spending time with his people. Nathan Buns will also need follow-up veterinary care to help address his ongoing medical needs.
dog.name: Nathan Buns
